name: cloud-firewall
description: MCP server for Check Point Cloud Firewall management

options.help: Create an API key for the Cloud Firewall service in the Infinity Portal and enter its Client ID.
Enter the Secret Key from the same Infinity Portal API key as the Client ID.
Your Infinity Portal account region: EU, US, AU, IN, AE, CA or JP. This is not your cloud deployment region. Defaults to EU.
Choose advisor (read-only) to inspect deployments, or write to also create deployments and request Azure VNet peerings. Defaults to advisor.

options.description: Advanced Cloud Firewall gateway environment (default prod)
options.help: Path segment in /app/cloud-firewall/<env>/api/v1. Leave unset unless instructed by Check Point support. Lowercase alphanumeric/dash, max 32 chars.

Full gateway origin. Leave unset unless instructed by Check Point support. Must be https and under checkpoint.com - the Infinity Portal token is sent to this host. Defaults to the region's production gateway.
Choose auto to detect the key type, service for an API key, or user for a user key. Defaults to auto.

options.description: Infinity Portal token forwarded by the MCP hosting platform
